response.text:
Thanks — I will not send or change anything until you confirm. Below I’ve cleaned up an invite/update message and listed the details I need to proceed. Tell me whether you want me to (A) update the existing calendar event, (B) send a separate follow-up email to attendees, or (C) both — and then confirm the items requested and say “send now.”

Polished draft (subject + invite/update body)
Subject: Update — Customer Advisory Board (Date) / Agenda & Pre-Read

Hi [Name / Team],

Thanks again for agreeing to join the Customer Advisory Board on [Date] at [Time] (Timezone). I wanted to share a brief update and the plan for the meeting:

• Agenda (high level)
  - 5 min: Welcome & goals
  - 30 min: Product roadmap highlights + feedback
  - 20 min: Customer priorities & pain points
  - 15 min: Next steps & action items

• Pre-read: [link or attachment] — please review before the meeting; it should take ~10 minutes.
• Confirmation: Please confirm your attendance by [RSVP deadline]. If the time no longer works, reply here and we’ll try to accommodate.
• Logistics: Location / Zoom link: [location or conferencing link]. If you need travel or accessibility accommodations, let me know.
• Contact: If you have items you’d like added to the agenda, send them to me by [date].

Looking forward to the discussion — your feedback is critical to shaping our roadmap.

Best,
[Your name / Organizer name]
[Title]
[Company]
[Contact info]

What I need from you to proceed
1. Which action do you want me to take?
   - A: Update existing calendar event (change title/body/attach pre-read)
   - B: Send a separate follow-up email to attendees (keeps event unchanged)
   - C: Both (update event + send follow-up email)

2. Event details / confirmations
   - If updating an existing event: the event title and date/time (or event ID), or tell me “update the event titled ‘Customer Advisory Board’ on [Date]”
   - Attendee list (or confirm “all current attendees”)
   - Timezone to use
   - Location / conferencing link (or say “no change”)
   - Any pre-read link or attachment to include (or tell me what to attach)
   - RSVP deadline (if you want one)
   - Any agenda edits or special notes to include (e.g., speaker names, panelists, moderated Q&A)

3. Send permission
   - Once you confirm the action and details, reply “send now” (or “update only,” or “email only”) and I will proceed.

If you prefer, I can propose a short subject line and a 1-line opener for a quick follow-up instead. Which option do you want, and please confirm the details above.
